verdict.rationale: Sketch's own feature docs confirm non-destructive boolean operations (Union, Subtract, Intersect, Difference) and shape styling for interface design. A community comparison implies vector editing exists but calls it buggier than Figma's, which counts against quality without contradicting a specific claim. Missing for 10: documentation of pen tool and path/point editing, documentation of precise alignment/distribution and snapping tools, independent hands-on corroboration of vector-editing quality.

support.subject: As a designer, I get professional vector tools — pen and path editing, boolean operations, precise alignment — for real interface design work
